intro_cards.title: What is Mandarin?
intro_cards.body: Mandarin is built from sounds, tones, and characters.
intro_cards.body_id: Mandarin terdiri dari bunyi, nada, dan karakter.

intro_cards.title: Pinyin
intro_cards.body: Pinyin helps you read Mandarin pronunciation using Latin letters.
intro_cards.body_id: Pinyin membantu kamu membaca pelafalan Mandarin dengan huruf Latin.

intro_cards.title: Tones
intro_cards.body: Mandarin uses tones. The same sound can mean different things if the tone changes.
intro_cards.body_id: Mandarin memakai nada. Bunyi yang sama bisa punya arti berbeda kalau nadanya berubah.

intro_cards.title: Tone sandhi
intro_cards.body: Sometimes tones shift in natural speech. The app will point this out when it matters.
intro_cards.body_id: Kadang nada berubah saat diucapkan natural. App ini akan memberi catatan saat hal itu penting.

intro_cards.title: Hanzi
intro_cards.body: Hanzi are Mandarin characters. Some are built from smaller components.
intro_cards.body_id: Hanzi adalah karakter Mandarin. Beberapa tersusun dari komponen kecil.

intro_cards.title: How this app works
intro_cards.body: Short lessons, quick practice, reviews, and unlocks help you build Mandarin step by step.
intro_cards.body_id: Pelajaran singkat, latihan cepat, review, dan unlock membantu kamu belajar bertahap.
